ETH.note: The training named reaches academic staff, students and community members, not civil servants.

facts.fact: The Ministry of Education's CEO for ICT and Digital Education says a nationwide International Certification of Digital Literacy training initiative is running, with 64 certified trainers across 50 public universities and TVET institutions and Amharic and Afaan Oromo content underway.

The Ministry of Education's CEO says the nationwide International Certification of Digital Literacy initiative has equipped over 12,000 academic staff and nearly 200,000 students with digital skills and reached close to 3,000 community members.
